context:
Goal: Slow CI jobs (Windows, mutation, macOS) stop running on every push to main and run once a day.
Problem (goal): you already allowed slow checks to run later, but only you can say whether the Windows and mutation tests leave the push to main along with macOS.
Based on (ruling): own-880-free-slots (your words, 11:52 CST Nov 15: "free as many slots as u can if stuff can be ran later that works for me"). It supersedes drop-nightly-schedule (done 16:01 CST Nov 14, which dropped the nightly run).
Based on (measured): Windows-only failures on 4 of 5 red pushes to main (Nov 13 to 15); about 4,700 runner minutes a day freed, before macOS (unmeasured); n=5 push runs, 3 days.
Departs from: main — adds one daily run at 02:47 CST and takes the Windows, mutation and macOS jobs off every push.
PR #3540 is the built change; the coordinator read it live at 13:31 CST.
holds: The merge of PR #3540 waits on this answer.

lastAnswer.note: Typed "A" in the consultant's chat at 01:43 CST Nov 16 (relayed by the consultant; triage did not see it typed). Release PR #3540 as built; the consultant drives it to ready.

options.gain: About 4,700 runner minutes freed per day.
options.how: PR #3540 goes ahead: one daily schedule (cron 47 8 * * *), and the Windows, mutation and macOS jobs leave push.
options.label: Yes, ship with the daily
options.lose: A Windows-only red reaches main up to about 24 hours later.

options.how: The daily schedule takes only mutation and macOS; Windows keeps running on every push.
options.label: Keep the Windows jobs on push, move only mutation and macOS
options.lose: Most of the freed minutes (Windows is 245 of 287 job-minutes per full run).

options.how: PR #3540 does not go ahead; push runs stay as they are.
options.label: Do not ship it

options.gain: Matches your words to turn off the Mac runs and run them at night, with no change to Windows or mutation.
options.how: A new, narrower pull request takes only macOS off push and onto the daily schedule; PR #3540 does not go ahead as built.
options.label: Move only the macOS jobs to the daily; Windows and mutation stay on push
options.lose: The Windows minutes stay on every push, and a new pull request has to be built and reviewed first.

reply: Closed: option a (ship PR #3540 with the daily). The consultant is driving it to ready. Your answer came by relay from his chat.

shown.label: Keep the Windows jobs on push, move only mutation and macOS
Move only the macOS jobs to the daily; Windows and mutation stay on push

title: May the Windows, mutation and macOS CI jobs leave every push to main and run once a day instead?
why: It frees the most runner minutes, and you said later runs work for you.
